prerequisites: Completion of all subjects in the curriculum is required for presenting the Final Degree Project. These requirements are subject to the specific regulations developed by the University of Salamanca and the Higher Polytechnic School of Zamora for regulating the preparation and presentation of Final Degree Projects.

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding and interpretation of texts and data, development of skills for concretizing them and their clear and concise exposition.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and time and their implementation in real situations.
Capacity for the oral and written transmission of concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering, clearly and correctly.
Capacity for the use of scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for the search for sustainable engineering solutions.
Capacity for teamwork and capacity for the development of multidisciplinary projects.
Capacity to relate to other people and an open aptitude towards creating new relationships.
Aptitude for professional insertion in diverse environments and with varied functions in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Capacity to incorporate new knowledge in the area of Industrial Engineering, based on the acquired and necessary training for the evolution of technology.
Development of autonomy and creativity capacities, which promote aptitudes for developing own initiatives and undertaking new projects.

Students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that builds upon general secondary education, and is usually at a level that, while supported by advanced textbooks, also includes some aspects implying knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

Students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional manner and possess the competencies that are usually demonstrated through the elaboration and defense of arguments and the resolution of problems within their field of study.
Students have the capacity to gather and interpret relevant data (normally within their field of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific, or ethical issues.
Students can transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences.
Students have developed those learning skills necessary to undertake further studies with a high degree of autonomy.
Understanding and mastery of basic concepts about the general laws of mechanics, thermodynamics, fields and waves, and electromagnetism, and their application to solving engineering problems.
Basic knowledge about the use and programming of computers, operating systems, databases, and computer programs with application in engineering.
Capacity to understand and apply the basic principles of general chemistry, organic and inorganic chemistry, and their applications in engineering.
Spatial vision capacity and knowledge of graphic representation techniques, both by traditional methods of metric geometry and descriptive geometry, and by computer-aided design applications.
Adequate knowledge of the concept of business, institutional and legal framework of the company. Organization and management of companies.
Knowledge of applied thermodynamics and heat transfer. Basic principles and their application to solving engineering problems.
Knowledge of the basic principles of fluid mechanics and its application to solving problems in the field of engineering. Calculation of pipes, channels, and fluid systems.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of materials science, technology, and chemistry. Understand the relationship between microstructure, synthesis or processing, and material properties.
Knowledge and use of the principles of circuit theory and electrical machines.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of electronics.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of automatisms and control methods.
Knowledge of the principles of machine and mechanism theory.
Knowledge and use of the principles of strength of materials.
Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems.
Basic knowledge and application of environmental technologies and sustainability.
Applied knowledge of business organization.

Capacity for solving mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge on: linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; differential and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithms; statistics and optimization.
Knowledge and capacities to organize and manage projects. Know the organizational structure and functions of a project office.
Knowledge and capacities to apply graphic engineering techniques.
Knowledge and capacities for the calculation, design, and testing of machines.
Applied knowledge of thermal engineering.
Knowledge and capacities to apply the fundamentals of elasticity and strength of materials to the behavior of real solids.
Knowledge and capacity for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.
Applied knowledge of the fundamentals of fluid-mechanical systems and machines.
Knowledge and capacities for the application of materials engineering.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.

teaching_methods: Orientation seminar for assignment and execution of work
Submission of written work in hardcopy and electronic version
Public exposition and defense before the corresponding tribunal
